name: EX-06 Staff Training — Virtual, Working Hours
description: 2-day virtual staff officer training exercise, working hours (0800–1700). Participants at different locations connected via MS Teams. Day 1 covers staff procedure modules; Day 2 applies them in a live scenario. Heavy use of standups and structured reporting. Contrast with EX-04 (co-located working hours).

locks.reason: Day 1 lunch break — virtual channels closed
Overnight recess — exercise resumes Day 2 at 0800
Day 2 lunch break — virtual channels closed

items.title: STARTEX
items.description: Day 1 begins. All participants connect to MS Teams. Synthetic time activated.

items.title: Virtual: Welcome & Exercise Overview
items.description: Exercise director opens Day 1. Overview of the 2-day programme, learning objectives, and how virtual tools will be used. Confirm all participants have access.

items.title: Module 1: Information Management
items.description: Structured training module. Staff procedures for information collection, processing, and dissemination. Includes shared document exercise on Teams.

items.title: Virtual: Module 1 Review Standup
items.description: Short standup via Teams. Each participant confirms: one thing learned, one question, one improvement suggestion for information management.

items.title: Module 2: Orders Process
items.description: Training on the five-paragraph field order format (SMEAC / SMESC). Practice writing abbreviated orders. Peer review via Teams shared doc.

items.title: Virtual: Lunch Coordination Sync
items.description: Brief sync before lunch. Confirm afternoon schedule, pre-read assignments for Module 3.

items.title: Module 3: Battle Rhythm Planning
items.description: Practical session on designing an exercise battle rhythm. Teams create a daily schedule using the Tidslinjal timeline. Share via screenshot to Teams channel.

items.title: Assignment: Design a 24h Battle Rhythm
items.description: Individual assignment distributed via Teams. Participants design a 24-hour battle rhythm for a fictional HQ. Due before Day 2.

items.title: Virtual: Day 1 Wrap-up
items.description: Day 1 close-out. Trainer reviews the day, previews Day 2 applied exercise, confirms assignment submission instructions.

items.title: Day 1 Close
items.description: Day 1 training concluded. Participants released for overnight recess. Complete and submit assignment before Day 2.

items.title: Virtual: Day 2 Morning Standup
items.description: Day 2 commences. Trainer reviews submitted assignments, confirms exercise objectives, and opens the applied scenario.

items.title: Applied Exercise — Phase Alpha
items.description: Live exercise scenario. Participants apply Day 1 skills in a realistic information management scenario. HQ operations running in Tidslinjal.

items.title: Virtual: SITREP Submission — Teams Form
items.description: Participants submit structured SITREP using the Teams form provided. Assessed on format, content, and timeliness.

items.title: Virtual: Decision Brief
items.description: Commander (trainer) presents a scenario decision point. Staff provide recommendations using the process from Module 2.

items.title: Applied Exercise — Phase Bravo
items.description: Second exercise phase. Increased information flow and competing priorities. Participants manage multiple simultaneous tasks.

items.title: Virtual: Lessons Observed Report
items.description: Each participant submits their lessons observed report via Teams. Three columns: observed, standard, recommendation.

items.title: Virtual: Final Debrief
items.description: Trainer-led debrief. Review of exercise performance against learning objectives. Participant feedback collected.

items.title: ENDEX
items.description: 2-day virtual training exercise concluded. Certificates issued post-exercise. Synthetic time deactivated.
